card.line: The Great Sea is the Mediterranean Sea, which marked the western edge of the land God promised to Israel.

moments.title: The western border
moments.text: God tells Moses that the coastline of the Great Sea will be Israel's western boundary. The northern border also starts from this sea.

moments.title: A promise to Joshua
moments.text: God tells Joshua that Israel's territory will reach west as far as the Great Sea. He promises to be with Joshua and never leave him.

moments.title: Kings along the coast
moments.text: When news of Israel's victories spreads, the kings in the hill country, the foothills, and along the coast of the Great Sea come together to fight Joshua and Israel.

moments.title: Judah's western edge
moments.text: The coastline of the Great Sea is named as the western border of the land given to the clans of Judah.

moments.title: Borders in Ezekiel's vision
moments.text: The Great Sea is again the western boundary of the land. The Lord GOD says it is to be divided among the twelve tribes, and foreigners who live among them are to receive an inheritance too.
